reviews.text: We greatly value our customers' opinions and thank Camila for taking the time to leave her review. It's a pleasure to know that our store met her expectations and that she had a positive experience. We look forward to continuing to offer excellent service on her future visits to Kiwoko, Mundo Animal.

Serpil, it's a real pleasure to receive such positive feedback as yours. We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to share your experience in our store. We hope to continue earning your trust and look forward to seeing you again soon at Kiwoko.

Thank you, Gemma, for taking a moment to rate us. We greatly value your opinion and are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us. We hope to continue being your trusted destination for all your pet needs.

It's a real pleasure to receive your positive feedback, Francesc. It motivates us to continue offering the best possible service for you and your pets. We hope to remain your trusted resource in the animal world.

I went to pick up an order I placed online. The person who served me was very friendly and the order was fine.
The store is very large, and it seemed well laid out, although since I was in a hurry I couldn't look too much.
Very well-stocked store and very friendly staff.

I went a few days ago to buy a few specific things, and I was truly delighted by the service and the politeness of the employee who helped me, offering advice every step of the way. The service was top-notch. I'll be back.

Terrible! Horrible service. A tall, dark-haired saleswoman treated my grandmother terribly. We always buy things for my dog ​​here, we buy the ice cream and it's always fine, but today my grandmother bought two and when she went to give them to the dog, she realized they were different, hard and impossible for him to chew. She went to complain and they told her that's how it was supposed to be, and my grandmother said it had never been like that before. The saleswoman said there was nothing she could do. It's true the product was on sale, but it was definitely expired or of poor quality. There was another woman who was also returning a product and another saleswoman responded rudely, saying, "YOU COME HERE TO BUY THINGS ON SALE AND NOW YOU'RE RETURNING THEM?!" Great customer service!! They shouldn't sell spoiled products, as they can harm our pets!! And the service was awful. We will never shop at KIWOKO again.

Terrible service at Kiwoko Gran Vía

Yesterday, Monday, July 27th, one of your employees treated me very rudely.

A couple of weeks prior, I purchased a defective product. Yesterday, I was there to return it, after two employees (a woman on the morning of the 16th and another man yesterday afternoon, the 27th) confirmed that the product was not working properly.
The price I paid was very low; I'm not complaining about losing €4. My displeasure stems from the way I was treated. It's true that I returned a day or two after the return deadline, but I still didn't deserve the treatment I received. A polite explanation that I could no longer return the item would have left me less upset.

Thank you for your positive feedback, Vincent. It's a pleasure to know that your experience at our establishment was satisfactory. We remain at your service for anything you may need, always committed to providing the best for you and your four-legged companions.
We're so glad to see your review, Laura! We sincerely appreciate you taking the time to share your opinion. We hope to continue being your top choice for all your furry friends' needs.
A top-notch place, they help you with everything they can and more. I've known them for years and they're very capable and competent people. (Thanks to the annoying parrot.)
Super attentive, kind, and with exquisite service, we'll be back! Thank you, ladies!

I've been shopping at Kiwoko for over five years now, and it's definitely become my go-to store for everything related to my cats.

It's always clean, tidy, and has great rotating offers. Plus, they have a thoughtful touch I love: they also cater to four-legged visitors, providing fresh water and snacks to make the walk—and the arduous task of accompanying their humans—more bearable.

But the best thing about the store is its staff. They always serve with a smile, are readily available to help, and demonstrate excellent knowledge, both of the products they sell and of animal behavior and the possible solutions for every situation. You can tell they enjoy their work and that they truly care about animals. Patricia, in particular, has been a lifesaver on more than one occasion.

The points and loyalty program is well worth it, and they now offer free home delivery. I'll continue to happily visit them, but I'm so grateful not to have to carry back cans of food, treats, and 14 kg of kibble all at once. That I almost always had to drop one off and come back for the other, either that same day or another. So 5 stars NO!!! 10 stars
